cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Can Handle This
cards.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'm ready for our audition results. Why are you breathing like that? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Four in, six out. It stops my hands shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. Four in, six out. I like to arrive already regulated.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I also write down who I'll call if I don't get in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Lend me your pen; my support network deserves advance notice.

mechanism: A leads waiting for audition results and claims readiness while adopting B breathing and support-list strategies, adjusting task roles to keep B alongside.
confusable: Unlike openly asking to be taught coping, A treats each newly supplied method as familiar preparation; the Stance negotiates who counts or writes.
comparison: Two audition candidates share preparation, unlike a helper taking over reading a rejection email.
seedUse: D114-a counted breathing and support contacts; S02-b adapts shared procedure to preserve cooperative authority.
